topic: Decide whether the prototype needs a small scenario direction before implementation.
agenda: Clarify whether narrative direction is needed for the next prototype slice.
Identify which choices are safe proposals and which require director approval.
Decide whether to create a follow-up WorkOrder.
known_constraints: Do not create implementation tasks from meeting consensus alone.
Do not write canon without Human Director approval.
Keep scope small enough for a solo prototype workflow.

discussion_turns.content: The story direction should serve the first playable loop. If it does not affect player motivation, it should stay optional.
Use early conflict inside the first playable loop, but keep protagonist motivation as an approval item until canon is decided.
Do not create new visual style requirements from this meeting. Story pitch can mention tone, but asset direction needs a separate approval item.
Recommend one follow-up WorkOrder for a canon-safe scenario pitch packet. No implementation and no asset import are authorized.

proposals: Create a narrative WorkOrder for a small scenario pitch and protagonist motivation approval packet.
objections: Do not treat the early conflict pitch as approved canon.
Do not create implementation, data, or asset tasks from this meeting.
unresolved_questions: Human Director must choose or reject protagonist motivation before canon memory can be written.
accepted_directions: Prepare a proposal packet, not canon or implementation.
rejected_directions: No asset style expansion from this meeting.
